run_pipeline_sana_video: run the SanaVideoPipeline to generate a video from a text prompt with specified height, width, and frames
encode_prompt_text_embeddings: encode a text prompt into Gemma text encoder hidden states with optional negative prompt and classifier-free guidance
prepare_video_latents: prepare random Gaussian latents for video generation with configurable batch size, frames, height, and width
retrieve_scheduler_timesteps: retrieve timesteps from a diffusion scheduler for a given number of inference steps with custom timesteps or sigmas support
clean_caption_text: clean and preprocess a caption string by removing URLs, HTML, special characters, and normalizing text for embedding
